pullAt20.what: median over validation origins of the cross-company Pearson correlation between the 20-session forecast and the move back to the 90-candle average close

steadyRiseAt20.what: mean 20-session forecast, in %, over 5 made-up steady rises from 100 to 130 in 90 sessions (the original drew -16.2%)

validationLoss.what: mean next-token loss over the fixed validation windows, both models scaled by the past alone
